_about: Grid Paper Editorial v4 (trained 5 Oct 2026 from 9 Top-100 refs: snippco r26, garrikedits r43, snipp.co r18, builtbyjaymark, gongkianist, rabinn.fx x2, ciggmedia, mirvogue; ~/reels/style-train/grid-paper-editorial). The speaker stays in natural colour with a clean grade; the ideas cut away to light paper pages (grid paper, clean, no CRT screen) that carry a mixed-type stack (small sans or serif lead, ONE big serif or condensed key, tiny caps connector) plus one black-and-white cut-out object, and a red accent: a hand-drawn circle around the key word, a red box word. Captions over the speaker are small white sans with the key word bigger. Hard cuts, no flashes or leaks. Measured medians: picture change every ~2.6 s (23/min), ~40% of frames are bright paper, mean luma ~120-160.

director.style: Grid Paper Editorial: a clean magazine-collage talking head. The speaker (natural colour, clean grade) carries the voice; the reel keeps cutting to LIGHT PAPER PAGES that set the key phrase as an editorial type stack with one black-and-white cut-out object, and a red accent (hand-drawn circle or red box) on the one word that matters. Light, airy, premium; never busy.
director.captions: captions.heroes: one hero per phrase (the noun or verb that carries the line), never a filler word. captions.serif: 1-3 heroes drawn in the display serif (emotional or abstract words). Natural case.
director.pages: Use ground beats ("matte": true in reel.json): the speaker CUT OUT on grid paper (paper grid) with ONE big key word behind/above the head (text, textColor ink #141414 or accent, textY ~250, textSize 170-300), 1.3-2.5 s each. Plus collage pages (paper grid, screen false): a small serif or caps lead, ONE big key (italic, serif, dark or box) and ONE engraving image (robot, brain, gears, laptop, team, chart, magnifier...). 3-4 pages in a 20 s reel (mostly ground cut-outs, at most 1-2 collages; about 30-40% of runtime on paper; hold each ground page through its whole phrase and start it on a take join so the page-in rides the jump cut), hard cuts, always back to the room footage between pages. Fewer pages beat more pages: every page adds two picture changes.
director.page_lines: Every word on a page is spoken WHILE the page is on screen and lands on its own spoken time. The first item is on the page from frame 1 (never blank paper).
director.lists: 'number one / two / three' items: a stack page per item with the numeral as the key (ring on the first and last only), or one collage page listing the items.
director.accent: Red is the only colour accent (circle, box, key word). The rest is ink black on off-white.
director.rhythm: Picture changes every ~2.6 s overall (punch-ins + pages). Never two pages back to back without the speaker. Leave the payoff on paper for ~1.5 s.
